name: Stan Korzybski
source: Anyone would say Stan is a typical nerd. He is a shy and usually quiet guy who works as a programmer from home. He spends most of the time in his room, glued to his computer screen, be it working, playing games, or who knows what else. It seems like most of his social life is conducted on-line, and he has no luck with the ladies. His clumsy social skills and unattractive appearance are to blame...
